$comment: THE SECTIONS' PHOTOS (BATCH LE-15, D6 signed 2026-10-19): about 40 free-licence photos, African schools first (RULE AF), each verified on its own page — Pexels License or Unsplash License, no credit required — resized to 480 and 800 px WebP, at most 40 KB (public/sections/). Written by scripts/research/section-photos.js; to replace one, put its new file and line in the raw manifest and run it again. Left out on purpose: a real school named in the picture, a named person's own portrait.
